'''Blueshift Propulsion''' was an influential [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] manufacturer that was wracked with corruption during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When a new chief executive was elected, outside advisors helped steer the company away from its corrupt policies and institute ethical business models.<ref name="Mission" />
